name: logo-carousel
title: Logo Carousel
description: A slim trust strip: three evenly spaced columns each show one brand mark, cycling through a list so a new logo blurs and rises into place every couple of seconds.
use: You want a slow, always-moving band of customer logos to signal trust without a static grid.
avoid: Logos must stay readable or clickable: they swap every two seconds and are not links.
a11y: Logos are decorative SVGs with no accessible names, and the endless cycling ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a near-black stage a small centred caption sits above three wide columns, each holding a single large logo, some white and some in brand colour. The columns are spaced apart with generous empty space around each mark.
behaves: Logos change on a timer, each column staggered so they do not swap together. The outgoing mark blurs and drifts up while the next fades into focus, and on first load the columns slide up into place.
customise: Only columnCount can be set from outside; the brand list and its SVG marks live in the file, so swapping logos means editing the source.
weight: light: A handful of SVG nodes and one 100ms timer; no canvas or layout work.
demo: Caption "Trusted by teams shipping at" with Apple, Stripe, Vercel, BMW, Lowe's and Supabase marks.
issues: A dark logo on the near-black stage nearly vanishes in several frames.
The strip never pauses on hover, so a logo can change while being read.
polishWhy: Smooth staggered blur transitions; a dark logo can disappear against the background.
